# Gigaflush

> Gigaflush is an open-source (GPL-3.0) menu-bar / system-tray app for macOS, Windows and Linux that finds rebuildable developer folders across your projects (node_modules, Rust target, Flutter build and .dart_tool, Python .pytest_cache/.mypy_cache/.ruff_cache, Swift .build, Gradle .gradle, Maven target), shows their sizes, and deletes the ones you choose after a review step. Folders are only matched when the project's marker file (package.json, Cargo.toml, pubspec.yaml, pyproject.toml, Package.swift, build.gradle, pom.xml) is beside them. Signed macOS and Windows builds cost $4.99 each; Linux builds are free; the source is on GitHub.
